page.overview:
What is Hecuba?

Hecuba is a Great Old One created by Big Finish Productions in 2013 for Doctor Who.

Hecuba is the sister of the Celestial Toymaker who ensnares sentient beings in time related games forcing them to stake their freedom on the outcome.

She has powers similar to the Celestial Toymaker's and appears as a very beautiful woman in a luxurious ballgown. A giant timepiece, the Grand Chronometer, which can manipulate time, stabilizes her pocket universe. She is coy and flirtatious, but takes her amusement from the pain and fear of her victims.
